name: GeoMapSkeleton
description: The map's box before anything is known: the same size, a silhouette when the region is.
signature: ({ region, insets, className }: { region?: MapRegion | null; insets?: MapInsets; className?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: insets
props.description: Page chrome over the map in CSS pixels, matching the GeoMap's `insets` so the placeholder frames the same way.

props.name: region
props.description: Region drawn as a silhouette; omit or pass `null` for an empty box.
